Title: Atomic Industries — The 21st Century Mass Production Company

URL Source: https://atomic.industries/

Markdown Content:
## The 21st Century Mass Production Company

The goal of Atomic is to move customers from design to production faster than anyone on earth. Our superpower is mold making, and our entire operation is AI-native.

01 Why Atomic

## The OS for Production

Traditional manufacturing is fragmented, slow, and opaque. Atomic unifies the entire stack into a single, software-defined process.

Category Today Atomic

Supply Chain Tier 1, 2, 3, and SMBs Vertically Integrated

Lead Time 8–16+ weeks 40–60% Faster

Tooling$50K+$0 Tooling Cost

Location Overseas / Foreign Detroit, Made in USA

02 Atomic's Engine

## Generative Physics Meets Manufacturing

Traditional manufacturing relies on expert intuition and iterative trial and error. Atomic replaces this with physics first engineering, using simulation and automation to compress design cycles and reduce downstream risk.

Our software stack models molten plastic flow, thermal behavior, and structural response to inform tooling and process decisions before metal is cut, and continues to improve as production data comes online.

#### Design for Manufacturability Insights

Early manufacturability signals derived from simulation and domain constraints. Highlights potential risk areas and informs tooling and process decisions, with human review where required.

#### Multi-Physics Simulation

Thermal, flow, and structural behavior evaluated together to guide tooling design, cooling strategy, and cycle optimization.

#### Closed-Loop Improvement

Production outcomes are captured and fed back into our models to refine future designs, processes, and assumptions over time.

03 Capabilities

## Production Capabilities

Atomic combines vertical integration with advanced volume production. Our facility features a fleet of heavy-tonnage presses and precision tooling capabilities to scale from concept to mass market.

### High-Volume & Large Scale

Equipped with 1000T, 1400T, and 2000T presses for mass production of large-format automotive body panels and defense components.

### Metal 3D Printing

Velo3D Sapphire printers enable conformal cooling channels in molds, drastically reducing cycle times and improving part density.

### Intelligent Quality

Real-time adaptive control and intelligent molding trials ensure consistent part quality across millions of cycles.

### Markets and customer types

Markets

04 Our Mission

## Rebuilding the Industrial Base

The 20th century was defined by mass production. The 21st century will be defined by AI-driven production.

At Atomic, we believe that the stagnation in hardware innovation is a direct result of a fragmented, archaic supply chain. We're building the operating system for the physical world—starting with the mold.

Our team combines computational physicists, veteran toolmakers, and engineers from SpaceX, Google, and Detroit's manufacturing floor, united by a single mission: make hard things easy to make.
